name: autotest-ai
description: Playwright + Gherkin (playwright-bdd) end-to-end tests with Claude Code guardrails

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); for (const d of ['.features-gen','test-results','playwright-report','blob-report']) { fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true}); for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(d)) fs.rmSync(path.join(d,entry),{recursive:true,force:true}); }"
scripts.test:parallel:headed: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test --workers=3 --headed
scripts.test:parallel:headless: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test --workers=3
scripts.test:debug: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test --debug
